title: 'Hollows rested' is the only counter besides 'Hollows burned' even though the game's own framing says every grief can be 'rested, bargained with, or burned.' Both bargains I struck (Thornwold's Hanged Company, Fenmarch's Drowned Congregation) were explicitly narrated by companions as 'Bargained, not burned, not rested outright' / 'Bargained, they are saying, not rested proper,' yet each incremented 'Hollows rested' by one in status.
where: status screen, Hollows rested tally (after Gallows Glade and Drowned Nave resolutions)
